name: Lecce (Italy)
description: White field charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Lecce (a she-wolf beneath a holm oak on white).
history: Municipal flag of Lecce, a comune in Apulia; Italian municipal arms, gonfaloni and flags are granted by decree of the President of the Republic on the advice of the Government's heraldry office.

features.role: Lecce arms — she-wolf beneath a holm oak on white, crowned
